additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380042-DC/Si-D/JO-[MP / R6 170002057] Issues with RFID Cards CRM:01811000351
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
Greetings of the day!
We have analyzed the logs and following are our observations:
For Charger Id: Yiqghh Sr.No. MP / R6 170002057
We found that the charger in on older FW version. We request you to bring the charger on latest FW version (atleast on
v4.0.11).
It may help in rectifying some issues.
After update if you are getting the same errors, please let us know. So that we can analyze further.
If you want to update the charger remotely, please let us know with the specific timestamp for the same.
For Charger Id: lj1Ik3 Sr.No. MP / R4 170001885
Here we checked and found that the OCPP backend (wss://wrenev.net:443/ocpp16) is not successfully integrated. It seems to be backend integration issue.
We request you to perform the BEI test. If already performed, could you please provide us with the report of the same.
In the logs we found that-
OCPP is continuously toggling online and offline.
Hence, the tag is not getting authorized. Or even though it is authorized, but due to toggling of OCPP connection during the charging session, the session is interrupted saying 'Authorization failed' or 'Authentication is not possible at the moment'.
Hence, you need to check the network/signal strength for OCPP or it can be the issue with the sim. Please check with sim card provider as well.
Also we noticed that-
When OCPP was offline, RFID was scanned multiple times. But it was not authorized as OCPP was offline. Hence, resulted in stop charging. (refer the image below)
Hope this answers your issue.
Kindly go through the steps mentioned above to resolve the issue. Also provide us with the requested information.
Once the above steps are performed, do let us know your observations to proceed further.
Do let us know if you have any other queries? We are happy to assist you further.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380042-DC/Si-D/JO-[MP / R6 170002057] Issues with RFID Cards CRM:01811000351
additional_info.body:
Hi Sadek,
Unfortunately, we (NOC) won't be able to join the call with the customer to troubleshoot it together, because it will conflict with the backend integration support process. Hope you understand it.
We have analyzed the logs and we couldn't find any issues related to the router at the moment.
First and foremost, the backend is not integrated with the Sicharge D.
Secondly, since Sicharge D complies to OCPP 1.6J standard, the charger was able to establish connection with the OCPP server, however this doesn't assure that all operation or functionality will work seamlessly.
So there must have been a functional test carried out with the OCPP server/backend provider, in this case it appears to be a self-test, so if you have performed a self-test, please be ready with the report in case you wihs to order the Integration test.
In case you doubt that the issue is caused by charger and not from backend, you can still order the expert services from service delivery team. Your contact in this case will be Afonso or Rui.
During the intervention if the defect is found at that charger's end, you can later re-imburse the cost through the warranty claim. [Only if the fault is at charger's end]
Lastly regarding the settings, you can advise OCPP Backend provider to modify (decrease the time) the below two parameters:
HeartbeatInterval = 180
WebSocketPingInterval = 60
Hope this explanation helps and wish this resolve the issue.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380042-DC/Si-D/JO-[MP / R6 170002057] Issues with RFID Cards CRM:01811000351
additional_info.body:
Dear Reetesh,
Thanks for the below clarifications and the recommended action has been conveyed to the customer.
Kindly let share with you the below points;
-Customer was requesting to whitelist some RFID cards, which is not supported by Si-D -until now- without OCPP Backend.
-Customer has been advised that to subscribe to any backend to be able to whitelist the RFID cards.
-Depofinity is not released to Jordan as some legal checks are still under process.
-Backend integration test is mainly to show guidance to the CPO how to configure basic things at there end in order to ensure compatibility with Siemens Si-D.
So based on the above;
1-The customer has subscribed for the backend
only
to activate the RFID cards, so asking the customer to pay 1200 Euro just to activate the cards doesn’t seem supportive for our future business with the same customer.
2-Kindly requested to shift the ticket to any of the backend team and spend at most 10-15 min for a site intervention.
Kindly looking for your feedback for point no.2 in case the feedback from the customer that Siemens recommendation didn’t work.
BR,
Sadek Hassanien
Regional Proposal Specialist-Emobility
Mobile: +974 74790868
https://www.siemens.com/global/en/products/energy/emobility.html

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380042-DC/Si-D/JO-[MP / R6 170002057] Issues with RFID Cards CRM:01811000351
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
Greetings of the day!
Find our answers below in red:
-Customer was requesting to whitelist some RFID cards, which is not supported by Si-D -until now- without OCPP Backend
-->
Charger supports 2 modes: 1) Free mode- without RFID and 2)Authorization mode -with RFID. And to authorize the RFID, it will require OCPP backend as it is done from backend itself.
-Customer has been advised that to subscribe to any backend to be able to whitelist the RFID cards.
-->
Yes, customer can choose any backend.
-Depofinity is not released to Jordan as some legal checks are still under process.
-->
It’s unfortunate that Depofinity hasn’t been released in Jordan yet due to ongoing legal checks. However, this matter falls under the Depofinity team, and not technical support team and hence they will be addressing it.
-Backend integration test is mainly to show guidance to the CPO how to configure basic things at there end in order to ensure compatibility with Siemens Si-D.
-->
Please note, backend integration is for smooth operation between Charger and OCPP.
So based on the above;
1-The customer has subscribed for the backend
only
to activate the RFID cards, so asking the customer to pay 1200 Euro just to activate the cards doesn’t seem supportive for our future business with the same customer.
--> The decision of payment lies with the customer/Regional or account management team/HQ. It does not lies with the NOC(Technical support team).
2-Kindly requested to shift the ticket to any of the backend team and spend at most 10-15 min for a site intervention.
--> Regarding this, we will request you to follow the settings that has been mentioned in the previous mail. Please check, if it helps you out after applying those settings. If it does not help and if you still want us to shift the ticket to backend team, we will do so, but we cannot assure if it will be free of cost or not. Backend team will decide further.
Hope your queries are being answered. Do let us know in case of any other queries.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
